results.item_about: As of 2025, this data set represents the official National Park Service centerline of the Lewis and Clark National Historic Trail Auto Route. The spatial data was created by the National Park Service with the assistance of interns from the U.S. Department of State Virtual Student Federal Service program. This layer was derived from roads data using TIGER/Line shapefiles from the U.S. Census Bureau.
